description: Publish a DrillFlow document and get back a shareable read-only link with working drill-down. The document format is documented at https://drillflow.de/en/format/. Publishing puts the diagram on a public read-only URL that anyone holding the link can open. Ask the user before publishing anything confidential.

document.description: A complete DrillFlow document object (id, title, rootDiagramId, diagrams).

name: publish_diagram
title: Publish a DrillFlow diagram
